messages.subject: Selectize OnChange
parts:
Hi,

I would like to use the onChange event to trigger a function when using selectize.js in shiny.  Currently, the only way to make that happen is to use the reactive method like observe or observeEvent.  This is good but this processing takes place at server end.  In my app, I would like to use the onchange in the UI to trigger a JS function which again will be running on the client side. 

PS:  I want to bypass the client server I/O and work entirely out of the client side.

Please let me know if this is possible

Thank you
SD
